subject: Re: CPPO readiness checklist & reseller go-live window
messages:
From: Maya Patel <ops@cloudresell.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: amanda.liu@amazon.com
Date: 2026-05-23T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: CPPO kickoff + go-live window (CloudResell / Redwood)

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier. CloudResell is targeting a soft-go-live for the Channel Private Offer (CPPO) on 2026-06-15 to coincide with our Q3 marketplace push. We need to confirm the operational checklist and a single point of contact from Redwood to drive entitlement mapping, billing setup, and DocuSign timing.

High-level asks:
- Confirm which SKUs/models will be listed and their entitlement mapping (we've attached our suggested mapping).
- Are there any API key or KMS handoff steps required for the CPPO entitlement flow?
- Can Redwood commit to a narrow SLA for activation (48 hours) once Amazon provisions the offer?

I've attached the entitlement_matrix.xlsx and a draft reseller contract for reference. Amanda — looping you in for any AWS readiness gates we should track.

Would appreciate a quick reply with names/roles and any immediate blockers.

Best,
Maya Patel
Operations Manager, CloudResell Inc

Attachment: entitlement_matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 72KB)
Attachment: reseller_contract_draft.docx (docx, 98KB)

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Maya Patel <ops@cloudresell.com>, amanda.liu@amazon.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-23T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO kickoff + go-live window (CloudResell / Redwood)

Hi Maya — thanks, and glad to partner on this. Quick answers and next steps below.

TL;DR: We can meet the 06/15 soft-go-live target if the entitlement mapping and AWS provisioning proceed on schedule. Rafael (me) will be your Redwood POC for go-live ops; Ben will own billing entitlements; Vanessa will lead integration/QA.

Actionable items we need from CloudResell by EOD 2026-05-26:
1) Final SKU-to-SUBSCRIBER mapping (confirmed in the attached entitlement_matrix).
2) Owner for DocuSign execution and legal redlines (we'll accept one consolidated redline set).
3) Confirm whether CloudResell requires KMS integration for customer-keyed encryption (if yes, we'll raise the private deployment checklist).

Notes:
- SLA: 48-hour activation window post-AWS provisioning is acceptable for normal cases; any special pricing entitlements (split-billing) may require longer coordination.
- Attachments: I've uploaded an internal CPPO_onboarding_checklist.pdf for your review — it lists the handoff steps we typically run through.

Cc'ing Ben and Vanessa to pick up the entitlement and invoicing threads. Amanda — let us know if Amazon needs any additional evidence artifacts from Redwood.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: CPPO_onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf, 45KB)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-23T10:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO kickoff + go-live window (CloudResell / Redwood)

Rafael / Vanessa — quick operational notes from billing side:

1) Entitlement matrix: The attached CloudResell file has a mixed SKU mapping (per-seat vs. consumption). We should standardize to consumption-based SKUs for minimal billing mismatches. I'll prepare a normalized sheet by EOD 05/25.
2) Invoices: For split-billing, we need reseller legal entity tax IDs and AP contacts. CloudResell: please send the AP contact and VAT/EIN info.
3) DocuSign: If legal sends redlines, ask for a single consolidated file. We will not accept iterative redlines across multiple threads — it delays signoff.

Soojin — can you confirm whether any platform-level flags are required for CPPO entitlements (e.g., feature gating)? If so, we need to schedule a 30-min integration window next week.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-23T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO kickoff + go-live window (CloudResell / Redwood)

Ben — short answer: yes, two flags.

Integration notes:
- Feature gating: we need a per-customer entitlement flag in our tenant-config to enable the CPPO SKU mapping. That requires a config push and a quick smoke test.
- KMS: if CloudResell requests customer-managed keys, that triggers the Private deployment path; we must treat that as a separate rollout with longer lead time.

Suggested schedule:
- 05/25: Ben delivers normalized entitlement sheet.
- 05/26: 30-min integration call to confirm flags and smoke test plan (I can host).
- 06/12: Dry-run activation on staging to validate DocuSign + entitlement activation.

I'll draft a brief runbook snippet for the smoke test and share it in the Docs link.

— Soojin
Platform Integrations Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@amazon.com>
To: Maya Patel <ops@cloudresell.com>, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-24T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO kickoff + go-live window (CloudResell / Redwood)

Thanks Rafael and team — Amazon side confirmations:

- CPPO provisioning ticket AMZ-78912 is open and currently in queue. We can accelerate if both parties provide the finalized entitlement matrix and DocuSign executed PO by 2026-06-01.
- For split-billing evidence, please upload the reseller legal docs to the linked partner console ticket.
- I'll also need a short test plan (1 page) showing the staging dry-run steps scheduled for 2026-06-12; please attach that to the ticket.

Maya — once you confirm the AP contact and signatory, Amazon will aim to provision the CPPO within 48 hours of receiving finalized artifacts.

Amanda Liu
AWS Partner Manager
AWS Marketplace
